# 觀音經玄義記會本科

**ID:** X0640
**Volume:** X35
**Category:** 法華部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／法華部疏
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0640

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* anonymous *kēwén* 科文 (sectional analysis / structural diagram) of the combined edition of Zhīlǐ's *Guānyīn xuányì jì* ([KR6d0047](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0047), T1727), preserved as X35n0640 in the *Xùzàngjīng*. The text is a structural-outline accompaniment to the combined edition (*huìběn* 會本) of [KR6d0052](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0052) in which Zhìyǐ's *Guānyīn xuányì* and Zhīlǐ's *Xuányì jì* are interwoven into a single readable text rather than circulating as separate works.

**Abstract**

The *Kēwén* belongs together with [KR6d0051](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0051) (the *tiáogè* 條箇 outline-by-headings) and [KR6d0053](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0053)–[KR6d0054](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0054) (the parallel apparatus on the *Yìshū jì*) as the auxiliary apparatus to the late-Míng combined-edition project on Zhīlǐ's *Pǔmén* corpus. Together these four works document a major late-Míng textual-editorial enterprise that reorganised the original Sòng *Pǔmén* commentarial corpus — Zhìyǐ's two works (*Xuányì*, *Yìshū*) and Zhīlǐ's two subcommentaries (*Xuányì jì*, *Yìshū jì*) — into a more accessible combined-edition format suitable for late-Míng monastic and lay readership.

The *Kēwén* was composed alongside the combined edition (*Huìběn*) of [KR6d0052](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0052), whose preface (by Wáng Jìcháng 王季常 居士 of the Gōngbù 工部) dates the project to Chóngzhēn 崇禎 1 (戊辰, 1628). The dating of the *Kēwén* itself is therefore most plausibly in the period 1628–1700 (extending the bracket to allow for late-Míng or early-Qing redactional activity).
